The '''P'frorin gotta-worm''' was a type of [[Worm/Legends|worm]]<ref name="Tethan" /> from<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[P'frorin system/Legends|P'frorin system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its body incorporated loops to a significant degree, and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|youngling]] active on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]<ref name="Tethan" /> of the neighboring [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]]<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Teth system/Legends|Teth system]]</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> was familiar with the worm.<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The P'frorin gotta-worm was mentioned in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In one adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, after encountering the eccentric<ref name="Tethan" /> Human<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|janugodalhi|Godalhi, Janu}}</ref> [[Historian/Legends|historian]] and security expert [[Janu Godalhi/Legends|Janu Godalhi]], the protagonist, a [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], thinks that he is "loopier than a P'frorin gotta-worm," a sentiment that, judging by the look on their friend [[Peder]]'s face, the youngling believes the latter shares.<ref name="Tethan" />
